name: setup_env
description: Provision the repo's toolchain (Go, Rust, Node, Python, …) into this workstream using Nix, so a dispatched agent can actually build and TEST its work rather than only editing files. Call it after bind_repo and before dispatch_agent when the repo needs a toolchain the base image lacks. Actions: 'detect' (report what the repo appears to need, changing nothing), 'provision' (materialize it — writes a flake.nix into the worktree you can inspect and tune), 'status' (what is currently active), 'teardown' (drop it).

action.description: What to do. 'detect' is read-only and safe to call first.

packages.description: Optional extra nixpkgs attribute names to add on top of what was detected, e.g. ['ffmpeg', 'postgresql']. Use exact nixpkgs names.
